extensionDescription.message: A fast SEO audit for the current page.

scanUnavailable.message: This page cannot be scanned. Open a regular HTTP or HTTPS page and try again.

fixTitleMissing.message: Add a unique, descriptive title between 30 and 60 characters.

issueTitleShort.message: The title is shorter than recommended.

issueTitleLong.message: The title is longer than recommended.

fixTitleLength.message: Aim for a clear title between 30 and 60 characters.

fixMetaMissing.message: Add a useful meta description between 120 and 160 characters.

issueMetaLength.message: The meta description length is outside the recommended range.

fixMetaLength.message: Rewrite the description to be between 120 and 160 characters.

issueH1Missing.message: The page has no H1 heading.

fixH1Missing.message: Add one clear H1 that describes the page topic.

issueH1Multiple.message: The page has multiple H1 headings.

fixH1Multiple.message: Keep one primary H1 and use H2 headings for sections.

issueImageAlt.message: Some images are missing alternative text.

fixImageAlt.message: Add concise, meaningful alt text to informative images.

issueUrlInvalid.message: The page URL is invalid or uses an unsupported protocol.

fixUrlInvalid.message: Use a valid HTTP or HTTPS page URL.

issueCanonicalMissing.message: The page has no canonical link.

fixCanonicalMissing.message: Add a canonical link that points to the preferred URL.

issueSchemaMissing.message: No structured data schema was detected.

fixSchemaMissing.message: Add relevant JSON-LD structured data where appropriate.

issueRobotsMissing.message: No robots meta tag was detected.

fixRobotsMissing.message: Add a robots directive when the page needs explicit crawl guidance.
